###Make figures and supplements for DOMC figure 3 - ECM-associated bacteria

#set working directory: setwd("~/Desktop/GAD_ELN/DO/Analysis/DOMC_Fig03_2024_11_17")

##{NOT IMPORTANT FOR THIS FIGURE -AG} Compare PLFA-based Bacterial (Gram+ (w/o Actinobacteria); Gram-; Actinobacteria) and Fungal (AMF; Others) functional categories with agglomerated DNA and RNA based categories.
#   Figure - stacked barchart? for now, jittered boxplots
#   Stat - Fisher's Exact Test (skipping for now)

## {REDUNDANT, DELETED -AG} Calculate actual fungal populations (ng/g) by multiplying RNA-based per-sample relative abundances to PLFA categories
#   ITS ASVs, functional groups, per-sample functional groups (in ng/g)

##Calculate ECM-associated 16S ASVs
#   Unfiltered DeSeq2

#   Figure - stacked barchart of abundance of significantly associated ASVs in samples
  
### {NOT IMPORTANT FOR THIS FIGURE -AG} PLFA-RNA-DNA comparison:

#load required packages:
```{r}
library("phyloseq")
library("ggplot2")
library("vegan")
library("tidyverse")
```

#load required data:
```{r}
ps16S <- read_rds("../microeco/Results/ps16S_faprotax.rds")
psITS <- read_rds("../Microbial Communities/Microbial_Community_ITS/Results/psITS_remove_8_reads_fungaltraits.rds")
fungal_functions <- read_csv("../Microbial Communities/Microbial_Community_ITS/Results/ITS_Functions_By_Sample/Primary_lifestyle_by_sample.csv")
metadata <- read_csv("../../TidyData/Metadata/Results/per_sample_metadata.csv")
```



#select relevant fungal PLFAs:
```{r}
PLFA_fungi <- select(metadata,
                        DO_ID,
                        PLFA_Arbuscular_Mycorrhizal_Fungi_ng_g,
                        PLFA_Saprotrophic_Fungi_ng_g)
```

#"Saprotrophic" here means "Not AMF:", rename:
```{r}
PLFA_fungi <- dplyr::rename(PLFA_fungi, PLFA_Other_Fungi_ng_g = "PLFA_Saprotrophic_Fungi_ng_g")
```

#relativize:
```{r}
PLFA_fungi_relative <- PLFA_fungi %>%
  mutate(
    fungi_ng_g = PLFA_Arbuscular_Mycorrhizal_Fungi_ng_g + PLFA_Other_Fungi_ng_g,
    PLFA_Arbuscular_Mycorrhizal_Fungi_relative = (PLFA_Arbuscular_Mycorrhizal_Fungi_ng_g / fungi_ng_g),
    PLFA_Other_Fungi_relative = (PLFA_Other_Fungi_ng_g / fungi_ng_g)
  ) %>%
  select(-fungi_ng_g,
         -PLFA_Arbuscular_Mycorrhizal_Fungi_ng_g,
         -PLFA_Other_Fungi_ng_g)
```

#fit to metadata:
```{r}
metadata <- left_join(metadata, PLFA_fungi_relative)
```

#select needed data:
```{r}
PLFA_fungi_relative <- select(metadata,
                                 DO_ID,
                                 core_bottom_depth_cm,
                                 Tree_Health,
                                 PLFA_Arbuscular_Mycorrhizal_Fungi_relative,
                                 PLFA_Other_Fungi_relative)
```


#gather data:
```{r}
PLFA_fungi_relative_long <- gather(PLFA_fungi_relative, "taxon", "abundance", 4:5)
```

#classic jittered boxplot:
```{r}
PLFA_fungi_relative_long_jitter <- PLFA_fungi_relative_long %>%
  
  #arrange(inoculation) %>%
  
  #mutate(inoculation = factor(inoculation, levels=c("water", "high_biofilm", "LTER_I", "LTER_NI", "Dairy_I", "Dairy_NI", "NE_I", "NE_NI"))) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = taxon, y = abundance, fill = taxon)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0,
               aes(x = taxon, y = abundance, fill = taxon)) +
  
  geom_point(aes(x = taxon, y = abundance, fill = taxon),
             position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = .75, jitter.width = .5),
             alpha = 1) +

  #scale_fill_manual(values=c("#99CCFF", "#CC6600", "#FFCC66",
                             #"#009900", "#00FF33"
   #                          )) +
  
  theme_classic()

PLFA_fungi_relative_long_jitter
```

#Get the RNA-based proportion of AMF fungi, per sample

#subset exclude controls:
```{r}
psITS
psITS <- subset_samples(psITS, core_top_depth_cm >= 0)
psITS
```

#select RNA-only:
```{r}
psITS
psITS_RNA <- subset_samples(psITS, nucleic_acid == "RNA")
psITS_RNA
```

#remove taxa that aren't in the dataset anymore:
```{r}
psITS_RNA
psITS_RNA <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(psITS_RNA) > 0, psITS_RNA)
psITS_RNA
```

#normalize data to relative abundance, rather than rarefying.
```{r}
psITS_RNA_relative <- transform_sample_counts(psITS_RNA, function(x){x / sum(x)})
```

#list available functional traits:
```{r}
rank_names(psITS_RNA_relative)
```

#select only one trait plus Genus and Species, to agglomerate correctly:
```{r}
rank_names(psITS_RNA_relative)

tax_table_psITS_RNA_relative <- tax_table(psITS_RNA_relative)

tax_table_select <- data.frame(tax_table_psITS_RNA_relative)

tax_table_select <- select(tax_table_select,
                           Primary_lifestyle,
                           Genus,
                           Species)

tax_table_select <- as.matrix(tax_table_select)
row.names(tax_table_select) <- row.names(tax_table_psITS_RNA_relative)
tax_table_select <- tax_table(tax_table_select)

tax_table(psITS_RNA_relative) <- tax_table_select

rank_names(psITS_RNA_relative)
```

#Agglomerate to Primary_lifestyle:
```{r}
psITS_RNA_relative <- tax_glom(psITS_RNA_relative, taxrank = "Primary_lifestyle", NArm = FALSE)
psITS_RNA_relative
```

#get ordered sample data:
```{r}
psITS_RNA_relative_sample_data <- data.frame(sample_data(psITS_RNA_relative))
```

#subsample only AMF from community:
```{r}
psITS_RNA_relative_AMF <- subset_taxa(psITS_RNA_relative, Primary_lifestyle == "arbuscular_mycorrhizal")
```

#list relative abundances:
```{r}
sample_sums(psITS_RNA_relative_AMF)
```

#Add these to the extracted sample data:
```{r}
psITS_RNA_relative_sample_data$RNA_Arbuscular_Mycorrhizal_Fungi_relative <- sample_sums(psITS_RNA_relative_AMF)
```

#Add inverse abundance:
```{r}
psITS_RNA_relative_sample_data <- mutate(psITS_RNA_relative_sample_data, RNA_Other_Fungi_relative = 1 - RNA_Arbuscular_Mycorrhizal_Fungi_relative)
```

#Select data:
```{r}
RNA_fungi_relative <- select(psITS_RNA_relative_sample_data,
                                 DO_ID,
                                 core_bottom_depth_cm,
                                 Tree_Health,
                                 RNA_Arbuscular_Mycorrhizal_Fungi_relative,
                                 RNA_Other_Fungi_relative)
```

#gather data:
```{r}
RNA_fungi_relative_long <- gather(RNA_fungi_relative, "taxon", "abundance", 4:5)
```

#classic jittered boxplot:
```{r}
RNA_fungi_relative_long_jitter <- RNA_fungi_relative_long %>%
  
  #arrange(inoculation) %>%
  
  #mutate(inoculation = factor(inoculation, levels=c("water", "high_biofilm", "LTER_I", "LTER_NI", "Dairy_I", "Dairy_NI", "NE_I", "NE_NI"))) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = taxon, y = abundance, fill = taxon)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0,
               aes(x = taxon, y = abundance, fill = taxon)) +
  
  geom_point(aes(x = taxon, y = abundance, fill = taxon),
             position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = .75, jitter.width = .5),
             alpha = 1) +

  #scale_fill_manual(values=c("#99CCFF", "#CC6600", "#FFCC66",
                             #"#009900", "#00FF33"
   #                          )) +
  
  theme_classic()

RNA_fungi_relative_long_jitter
```

```{r}
DNA_bacteria_relative_long_jitter <- DNA_bacteria_relative_long %>%
  
  #arrange(inoculation) %>%
  
  #mutate(inoculation = factor(inoculation, levels=c("water", "high_biofilm", "LTER_I", "LTER_NI", "Dairy_I", "Dairy_NI", "NE_I", "NE_NI"))) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = taxon, y = abundance, fill = taxon)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0,
               aes(x = taxon, y = abundance, fill = taxon)) +
  
  geom_point(aes(x = taxon, y = abundance, fill = taxon),
             position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = .75, jitter.width = .5),
             alpha = 1) +

  #scale_fill_manual(values=c("#99CCFF", "#CC6600", "#FFCC66",
                             #"#009900", "#00FF33"
   #                          )) +
  
  theme_classic()

DNA_bacteria_relative_long_jitter
```

#join datasets:

#fungi:
```{r}
PLFA_fungi_relative_long$molecule <- "PLFA"
RNA_fungi_relative_long$molecule <- "RNA"
DNA_fungi_relative_long$molecule <- "DNA"

fungi_relative_long <- rbind(PLFA_fungi_relative_long, RNA_fungi_relative_long, DNA_fungi_relative_long)

fungi_relative_long <- fungi_relative_long %>% mutate(taxon = str_remove_all(taxon, "PLFA_"))
fungi_relative_long <- fungi_relative_long %>% mutate(taxon = str_remove_all(taxon, "RNA_"))
fungi_relative_long <- fungi_relative_long %>% mutate(taxon = str_remove_all(taxon, "DNA_"))
```

#bacteria:
```{r}
PLFA_bacteria_relative_long$molecule <- "PLFA"
RNA_bacteria_relative_long$molecule <- "RNA"
DNA_bacteria_relative_long$molecule <- "DNA"

bacteria_relative_long <- rbind(PLFA_bacteria_relative_long, RNA_bacteria_relative_long, DNA_bacteria_relative_long)

bacteria_relative_long <- bacteria_relative_long %>% mutate(taxon = str_remove_all(taxon, "PLFA_"))
bacteria_relative_long <- bacteria_relative_long %>% mutate(taxon = str_remove_all(taxon, "RNA_"))
bacteria_relative_long <- bacteria_relative_long %>% mutate(taxon = str_remove_all(taxon, "DNA_"))
```

#plot, color by molecule, panel by taxon

```{r}
bacteria_relative_long_jitter <- bacteria_relative_long %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = molecule, y = abundance, fill = molecule)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0,
               aes(x = molecule, y = abundance, fill = molecule)) +
  
  geom_point(aes(x = molecule, y = abundance, fill = molecule),
             position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = .75, jitter.width = .5),
             alpha = 1) +
  
  facet_grid(cols = vars(taxon)) +
  
  theme_classic()

bacteria_relative_long_jitter
```

## Correct ITS read abundances by their per-sample population (PLFA); multiply RNA-based read counts by PLFA ng/g

#Use DeSeq2 to find significantly correlated 16S ASVs and genera with ECM ng/g, in living and dead trees.

#ASVs, RNA

#load required packages:
```{r}
library("phyloseq")
library("vegan")
library("tidyverse")
library("DESeq2")
```

#load required data:
```{r}
ps16S <- read_rds("../microeco/Results/ps16S_faprotax.rds")
psITS <- read_rds("../Microbial_Community_ITS/Results/psITS_remove_8_reads_fungaltraits.rds")
```

#read depths:
```{r}
sort(sample_sums(psITS))
```

#subset exclude controls:
```{r}
psITS
psITS <- subset_samples(psITS, core_top_depth_cm >= 0)
psITS
```

#select RNA-only:
```{r}
psITS
psITS_RNA <- subset_samples(psITS, nucleic_acid == "RNA")
psITS_RNA
```

#remove taxa that aren't in the dataset anymore:
```{r}
psITS_RNA
psITS_RNA <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(psITS_RNA) > 0, psITS_RNA)
psITS_RNA
```

#get sample data:
```{r}
psITS_RNA_sample_data <- data.frame(sample_data(psITS_RNA))
```

#select PLFA data:
```{r}
PLFA_total_fungi <- select(psITS_RNA_sample_data, PLFA_Total_Fungi_ng_g)
PLFA_total_fungi <- PLFA_total_fungi$PLFA_Total_Fungi_ng_g
```

#transform to relative abundances:
```{r}
psITS_RNA_relative <- transform_sample_counts(psITS_RNA, function(x){x / sum(x)})
```

#pre-transform sample sums:
```{r}
sample_sums(psITS_RNA_relative)
```

#transform ASV table:
```{r}
# Divide the counts in sample n by size_factors[n] and save in matrix `mat`
mat <- sweep(otu_table(psITS_RNA_relative), 1 + taxa_are_rows(psITS_RNA_relative), PLFA_total_fungi, FUN = `*`)

# Make a new phyloseq object with the transformed counts
psITS_RNA_relative_PLFAcorr <- psITS_RNA_relative
otu_table(psITS_RNA_relative_PLFAcorr) <- otu_table(mat, taxa_are_rows = taxa_are_rows(psITS_RNA_relative))
```

#post-transform sample sums:
```{r}
sample_sums(psITS_RNA_relative_PLFAcorr)
```

#should match PLFA numbers:
```{r}
PLFA_total_fungi
```

#worked.

#re-calculate per-sample fungal functional traits for append to 16S.

#List 'taxonomic' ranks"
```{r}
rank_names(psITS_RNA_relative_PLFAcorr)
```

#rename (pre-written code):
```{r}
psITS_fungaltraits_relative <- psITS_RNA_relative_PLFAcorr
```

#extract taxa table
```{r}
# Extract abundance matrix from the phyloseq object
TAXA1 <- as(tax_table(psITS_fungaltraits_relative), "matrix")
# Coerce to data.frame
psITS_fungaltraits_taxa <- as.data.frame(TAXA1)
# Save as .csv
#write_csv(psITS_fungaltraits_taxa, "Results/Fungal_Traits_Taxa_Table.csv")
```

#Extract OTU table
```{r}
# Extract abundance matrix from the phyloseq object
OTU1 <- as(otu_table(psITS_fungaltraits_relative), "matrix")
# Coerce to data.frame
psITS_fungaltraits_OTU <- as.data.frame(OTU1)
# Save as .csv
#write_csv(psITS_fungaltraits_OTU, "Results/Fungal_Traits_OTU_Table.csv")
```

#Extract sample names
```{r}
samplenames <- as.data.frame(sample_names(psITS_fungaltraits_relative))
#write_csv(samplenames, "Results/Fungal_Traits_Sample_Names.csv")
```

#Vandepol split genus Mortierella in 2020 - manually assigning genus mortierella's functions to what are now genera actinomortierella, gryganskiella, linnemannia, lunasporangiospora, necromortierella, podila.
#Note this in the methods.

#Add samplenames to first column of OTU_Table:
```{r}
psITS_fungaltraits_OTU <- rownames_to_column(psITS_fungaltraits_OTU, var = "DO_sample_names")
```

### 1:Primary_lifestyle

#replace entire first row of OTU_table with Primary_lifestyle column of Taxa_table.csv, including heading.
```{r}
Primary_lifestyle_transposed <- t(psITS_fungaltraits_taxa$Primary_lifestyle)
Primary_lifestyle_transposed <- as.data.frame(Primary_lifestyle_transposed)
column_title <- as.data.frame(c("Primary_lifestyle"))
Primary_lifestyle_transposed <- bind_cols(column_title, Primary_lifestyle_transposed)
colnames(Primary_lifestyle_transposed) <- colnames(psITS_fungaltraits_OTU)
psITS_fungaltraits_OTU <- data.frame(lapply(psITS_fungaltraits_OTU, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
Primary_lifestyle <- bind_rows(Primary_lifestyle_transposed, psITS_fungaltraits_OTU)
```

#transpose, fix column names, remove rownames (ASVs), re-code as numeric:
```{r}
Primary_lifestyle <- t(Primary_lifestyle)

colnames(Primary_lifestyle) <- as.character(Primary_lifestyle[1, ])
Primary_lifestyle <- as.data.frame(Primary_lifestyle[-1, ])
rownames(Primary_lifestyle) <- NULL

recode_numeric <- select(Primary_lifestyle, -Primary_lifestyle)
recode_numeric <- data.frame(lapply(recode_numeric, as.numeric))

Primary_lifestyle <- bind_cols(Primary_lifestyle$Primary_lifestyle, recode_numeric)
Primary_lifestyle <- dplyr::rename(Primary_lifestyle, Primary_lifestyle = "...1")
```

#collapse all duplicate values:
```{r}
metadata_Primary_lifestyle_grouped <- Primary_lifestyle %>%
  group_by(Primary_lifestyle) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum))
```

#Transpose, edit for later leftjoin:
```{r}
metadata_Primary_lifestyle_grouped_t <- as.data.frame(t(metadata_Primary_lifestyle_grouped))
metadata_Primary_lifestyle_grouped_t <- rownames_to_column(metadata_Primary_lifestyle_grouped_t, var = "Sequencing_ID")
```

#check sums:
```{r}
checksums <- metadata_Primary_lifestyle_grouped_t
checksums <- checksums[-1,-1]
checksums <- mutate(checksums, across(everything(), as.numeric))
checksums <- mutate(checksums, traitsums = rowSums(across(everything())))

checksums$traitsums
```

#export collapsed metadata:
```{r}
write_csv(metadata_Primary_lifestyle_grouped_t, "Results/Primary_lifestyle_by_sample.csv", col_names = FALSE)
```

### 17: secondary_photobiont

#replace entire first row of OTU_table with secondary_photobiont column of Taxa_table.csv, including heading.
```{r}
secondary_photobiont_transposed <- t(psITS_fungaltraits_taxa$secondary_photobiont)
secondary_photobiont_transposed <- as.data.frame(secondary_photobiont_transposed)
column_title <- as.data.frame(c("secondary_photobiont"))
secondary_photobiont_transposed <- bind_cols(column_title, secondary_photobiont_transposed)
colnames(secondary_photobiont_transposed) <- colnames(psITS_fungaltraits_OTU)
psITS_fungaltraits_OTU <- data.frame(lapply(psITS_fungaltraits_OTU, as.character), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
secondary_photobiont <- bind_rows(secondary_photobiont_transposed, psITS_fungaltraits_OTU)
```

#transpose, fix column names, remove rownames (ASVs), re-code as numeric:
```{r}
secondary_photobiont <- t(secondary_photobiont)

colnames(secondary_photobiont) <- as.character(secondary_photobiont[1, ])
secondary_photobiont <- as.data.frame(secondary_photobiont[-1, ])
rownames(secondary_photobiont) <- NULL

recode_numeric <- select(secondary_photobiont, -secondary_photobiont)
recode_numeric <- data.frame(lapply(recode_numeric, as.numeric))

secondary_photobiont <- bind_cols(secondary_photobiont$secondary_photobiont, recode_numeric)
secondary_photobiont <- dplyr::rename(secondary_photobiont, secondary_photobiont = "...1")
```

#Test ECM ng/g as a numeric predictor.

#Filter for only samples with %ECM:
```{r}
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent

ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent
```

#scale and center ECM - to interpret as logfold change per 100 ng/g ECM increments:
```{r}
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent_sample_data <- data.frame(sample_data(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent))

ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent_sample_data <- mutate(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent_sample_data, ECM_scaled = (((ectomycorrhizal) - mean(ectomycorrhizal))/100))

sample_data(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent) <- ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent_sample_data

ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent
```

#use deseq2 to find microbes that are differentially abundant with greater % ECM:
```{r}
DESeq_ECM <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(physeq = ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent, design = ~ECM_scaled)
DESeq_ECM <- DESeq(DESeq_ECM, test = "Wald", fitType = "parametric")
```

#DESeq2 Results:
```{r}
DESeq_ECM_Results <- results(DESeq_ECM, cooksCutoff = FALSE)
alpha <- 0.05
sigtab <- DESeq_ECM_Results[which(DESeq_ECM_Results$padj < alpha), ]
sigtab <- cbind(as(sigtab, "data.frame"), as(tax_table(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent)[rownames(sigtab), ], "matrix"))
dim(sigtab)

write_csv(sigtab, "Results/DESeq2_16S_ASVs_RNA_ECM_2trees.csv")
```

#Visualize
```{r}
library("ggplot2")
theme_set(theme_bw())
#scale_fill_discrete <- function(palname = "Set1", ...) {
#    scale_fill_brewer(palette = palname, ...)
#}
# Phylum order
x = tapply(sigtab$log2FoldChange, sigtab$Phylum, function(x) max(x))
x = sort(x, TRUE)
sigtab$Phylum = factor(as.character(sigtab$Phylum), levels=names(x))
# Genus order
x = tapply(sigtab$log2FoldChange, sigtab$Genus, function(x) max(x))
x = sort(x, TRUE)
sigtab$Genus = factor(as.character(sigtab$Genus), levels=names(x))
ggplot(sigtab, aes(x=Genus, y=log2FoldChange, color=Phylum)) + geom_point(size=6) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90, hjust = 0, vjust=0.5))
```

#many significant asvs

#designate ASVs (pre-written code):

```{r}
ps16S_ASVs_RNA <- ps16S_RNA
```

#list available functional traits:
```{r}
rank_names(ps16S_ASVs_RNA)
```

#select only one trait plus Species, to agglomerate correctly:
```{r}
rank_names(ps16S_ASVs_RNA)

tax_table_ps16S_ASVs_RNA <- tax_table(ps16S_ASVs_RNA)

tax_table_select <- data.frame(tax_table_ps16S_ASVs_RNA)

tax_table_select <- select(tax_table_select,
                           combined_traits,
                           Genus,
                           Species)

tax_table_select <- as.matrix(tax_table_select)
row.names(tax_table_select) <- row.names(tax_table_ps16S_ASVs_RNA)
tax_table_select <- tax_table(tax_table_select)

tax_table(ps16S_ASVs_RNA) <- tax_table_select

rank_names(ps16S_ASVs_RNA)
```

#Agglomerate to combined_traits:
```{r}
ps16S_ASVs_RNA <- tax_glom(ps16S_ASVs_RNA, taxrank = "combined_traits", NArm = FALSE)
ps16S_ASVs_RNA
```


#To start, filter for traits seen in at least 1 time under each of 2 trees:
```{r}
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_for_filter <- ps16S_ASVs_RNA

ps16S_ASVs_RNA_for_filter <- merge_samples(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_for_filter, "Tree")
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_for_filter

ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant <- filter_taxa(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_for_filter, function(x) sum(x > 1) >= 2, TRUE)
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant
```

#How much of the community do these represent?

#First, relativize phyloseq:
```{r}
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_relative <- transform_sample_counts(ps16S_ASVs_RNA, function(x){(x / sum(x))})
```

#Next, get names of subsetted taxa:
```{r}
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_names <- names(taxa_sums(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant))
```

#Subset relativized dataset:
```{r}
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_relative
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_relative_abundant <- prune_taxa(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_names, ps16S_ASVs_RNA_relative)
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_relative_abundant
```

#Bar graph:
```{r}
plot_bar(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_relative_abundant, x = "DO_ID", y = "Abundance", fill = "combined_traits")
```

#would have to export that to see it; assume it's fine.

#Subset un-relativized dataset for analysis:
```{r}
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent <- prune_taxa(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_names, ps16S_ASVs_RNA)
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent

sort(sample_sums(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent))
```

#deseq2 does not run on relativized data. rarefy to common depth, post-filtering:
```{r}
sort(sample_sums(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent))

ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent <- rarefy_even_depth(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent, sample.size = 25427, rngseed = 12, replace = TRUE, trimOTUs = TRUE)

sort(sample_sums(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent))
```


#Test ECM ng/g as a numeric predictor.

#Filter for only samples with %ECM:
```{r}
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent <- subset_samples(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent, ectomycorrhizal != "NA")
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent
```

#scale and center ECM - to interpret as logfold change per 100 ng/g ECM increments:
```{r}
ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent_sample_data <- data.frame(sample_data(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent))

ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent_sample_data <- mutate(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent_sample_data, ECM_scaled = (((ectomycorrhizal) - mean(ectomycorrhizal))/100))

sample_data(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent) <- ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent_sample_data

ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent
```

#use deseq2 to find microbes that are differentially abundant with greater % ECM:
```{r}
DESeq_ECM <- phyloseq_to_deseq2(physeq = ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent, design = ~ECM_scaled)
DESeq_ECM <- DESeq(DESeq_ECM, test = "Wald", fitType = "parametric")
```

#DESeq2 Results:
```{r}
DESeq_ECM_Results <- results(DESeq_ECM, cooksCutoff = FALSE)
alpha <- 0.05
sigtab <- DESeq_ECM_Results[which(DESeq_ECM_Results$padj < alpha), ]
sigtab <- cbind(as(sigtab, "data.frame"), as(tax_table(ps16S_ASVs_RNA_abundant_onepercent)[rownames(sigtab), ], "matrix"))
dim(sigtab)

write_csv(sigtab, "Results/DESeq2_16S_ASVs_RNA_ECM_2trees_traits.csv")
```
